mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and higher inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month & UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related industries and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy in the face of inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month & CPIAUCSL > previous month
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases, but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.
